summary: com.apple.unityplugin.storekit beacons host identifiers to oast.fun on import
details: Package published under the com.apple.* namespace with author 'Apple, Inc' ships a 12-line index.js and no StoreKit functionality. On require/import, index.js issues an HTTPS GET to a hardcoded interactsh-style subdomain (dapnhid534ch06s9vpm0mbg1httu5gytc.oast.fun) with the package name, os.platform(), and os.hostname() as query parameters. The impersonation of an internal Apple namespace combined with a recon-only import-time beacon to an out-of-band interaction collector is a dependency-confusion reconnaissance payload: installing or requiring the package causes the installer's hostname and OS to be exfiltrated to an attacker-controlled collector, confirming that the internal package name resolves on that build system.
